from pathlib import Path
import collections,json,hashlib
base=Path('.local/tool-tasks/exhaust-extension-writer-audit-20261007')
runtime=json.loads((base/'runtime-reference-inventory.json').read_text())
game=json.loads((base/'game-reference-inventory-v6.json').read_text())
patches=json.loads(Path('docs/performance/exhaust-root-extension-audit-20261007.json').read_text())['initialInventory']['NativePatches']
assert runtime['schemaVersion']==game['schemaVersion']==6
assert runtime['dllSha256']=='fe387f765a3951690b161c129731e6c10016215c06074aa3356dd96290f13b52'
assert game['dllSha256']=='2b40d2df538db1ceb5fa48d958c80ab730ada1e07db88a870aff01a661768b9f'
def parts(signature):
 head=signature.split('::',1)
 return (head[0].rsplit(' ',1)[-1],head[1].split('(',1)[0]) if len(head)==2 else ('','')
def api(signature):
 owner,name=parts(signature)
 if owner=='STS2RitsuLib.Cards.FreePlay.FreePlayBindingRegistry':
  return name.startswith(('Mark','Clear')) or name in ['Register','Resolve']
 if owner=='STS2RitsuLib.Combat.SecondaryResources.SecondaryResourceCardExtensions':
  return name.startswith(('Copy','Reset','Clear')) or name in ['SecondaryCosts','SecondaryResourceUses']
 if owner=='STS2RitsuLib.Combat.SecondaryResources.SecondaryResourceCostSet':
  return name.startswith(('Set','Clear','Reset')) or name in ['Clone','GetLayers']
 if owner=='STS2RitsuLib.Combat.SecondaryResources.SecondaryResourcePlayUseSet':
  return name.startswith(('Set','Require','Spend','Clear','Reset')) or name in ['Clone','GetLayers']
 if owner=='STS2RitsuLib.Combat.SecondaryResources.ModSecondaryResourceRegistry':
  return name in ['Register','For']
 return False
refs=runtime['staticReferences']+runtime['asyncMappings']
direct=[row for row in refs if api(row['Target'])]
seeds={row['Target'] for row in direct}
def reverse_closure(refs,seeds):
 incoming=collections.defaultdict(list)
 for row in refs:incoming[row['Target']].append(row)
 seen=set();via={m:None for m in seeds};queue=collections.deque(sorted(seeds))
 while queue:
  method=queue.popleft()
  if method in seen:continue
  seen.add(method)
  for row in incoming.get(method,[]):
   caller=row['Caller']
   if caller not in via:via[caller]=row;queue.append(caller)
 return seen,via
seen,via=reverse_closure(refs,seeds)
patchnames={owner.replace('/','+')+'.'+name for method in seen for owner,name in [parts(method)]}
bridges=[row for row in patches if row['PatchAssembly']=='STS2-RitsuLib.Runtime' and row['Patch'] in patchnames]
bridge_targets={row['Target'] for row in bridges if row['TargetAssembly']=='sts2'}
game_refs=game['staticReferences']+game['asyncMappings']
game_names={row['Caller'] for row in game_refs}|{row['Target'] for row in game_refs}
game_seeds={m for m in game_names if '.'.join(parts(m)) in bridge_targets}
game_seen,game_via=reverse_closure(game_refs,game_seeds)
summary={'runtimeTypes':runtime['typeCount'],'runtimeMethods':runtime['methodCount'],
 'runtimeDisplaySignatureGroups':len(runtime['ambiguousMethodSignatures']),
 'scopedWriterApiTargets':len(seeds),'directWriterApiReferences':len(direct),
 'runtimePotentialCallerMethods':len(seen),'possiblePatchBridges':len(bridges),
 'nativeTargetNames':len(bridge_targets),'nativeMethodSeeds':len(game_seeds),
 'nativePotentialCallerMethods':len(game_seen),
 'displaySignatureCollisionsInRuntimeClosure':sum(row['signature'] in seen for row in runtime['ambiguousMethodSignatures'])}
result={'schemaVersion':1,'summary':summary,'isSafetyCertificate':False,
 'writerApiTargets':sorted(seeds),'directWriterApiReferences':direct,
 'runtimePotentialCallerMethods':sorted(seen),'runtimeWitnessEdges':via,
 'possibleNativePatchBridges':bridges,'nativeMethodSeeds':sorted(game_seeds),
 'nativePotentialCallerMethods':sorted(game_seen),'nativeWitnessEdges':game_via,
 'limitations':[
  'manually scoped API-name worklist is not all possible field/alias/reflection writers',
  'static and ldftn/async edges indicate potential references, not runtime or branch reachability',

  'native method closure includes noncombat, UI, save and network entrypoints',
  'no current root registration snapshot, finite future source closure or per-branch guard established']}
(base/'writer-api-worklist.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
(base/'writer-api-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(summary))
